title: Gham koun jaane aapka aye Abid e muztar
body:
AYE SHAH KEY DILBAR, AYE SHAH KEY DILBAR
<<MINI>>
GHAM KOUN JAANE APKA AYE ABID-E-MUZTAR
<<DIVIDER>>
PYASOUN KO YAAD KARKE SADA KARTE THE FUGHAN
AANKHAON SE ASHK-E-GHAM NAHIKHOON HOTA THA RAWAN
MAQLUQ SAARI ROTI THI, ROTE THE IS QADAR
<<MINI>>
GHAM KOUN JAANE APKA AYE ABID-E-MUZTAR…..
<<DIVIDER>>
HAR DAM NAZAR KEY SAMNE ZINDAN-E-SHAAM THA
CHOTI BAHEN SAKINA PE RONE SE KAAM THA
AANSU KI THI SABEELE, SAKINA KEY NAAM PAR
ZAINAB KI BERIDAAI PAR ROYE RASUL-E-PAAK
<<DIVIDER>>
IS BERIDAYI PAR HUA ZEHRA KA DIL BHI CHAAK
KIHOON RORAHE THE SHAAM MEIN, TAB ABID-E-MUZTAR
AAKAR JINA SE HAZRAT-E-AYYUB DEKHIYE
ABID KA SABR DEKHIYE OUR KUCH TO BOLIYE
<<DIVIDER>>
YE HAQ HAI AHLEBAIT KA, KEHTE THE PAYAMBAR
<<MINI>>
GHAM KOUN JAANE APKA AYE ABID-E-MUZTAR…..
<<DIVIDER>>
PUCHA KISINE ARZ KAREIN GHAM KI DASTAAN
SABSE ZIYADA AAP PE GHAM TOOTE HEIN KAHAN
AASHAAM KEH KEY RODIYA, MAZLOOM KA PISAR
<<MINI>>
GHAM KOUN JAANE APKA AYE ABID-E-MUZTAR…..
